The underlying mechanisms of these findings are unclear but may be related to a greater time under tension, essentially corresponding to a higher volume or perhaps higher mechanical tension achieved by extended loading at long muscle lengths. However, it should be noted that these data have not been published in a peer-reviewed journal and thus must be interpreted with circumspection.
